{
                                request_user: {
                                    '@odata.type': "#Microsoft.Azure.Connectors.SharePoint.SPListExpandedUser",
                                    Claims: "i:0#.f|membership|" & Lower(User().Email),
                                    DisplayName: User().FullName,
                                    RequestingAgencyEmail: User().Email,
                                    Department: "",
                                    JobTitle: "",
                                    Picture: ""
                                },
                                time_submitted: Now(),
                                /*Destination: BOT.Text,*/
                                Destination: If(Destination.Selected.Value = "British Overseas Territories (BOTs)", Destination.Selected.Value & " - " & BOT.Text, Destination.Selected.Value),
                                OneTimeVisit: OneTimeVisit.Checked,
                                RecurringVisit: RecurringVisit.Checked,
                                EmergencyVisit: EmergencyVisit.Checked,
                                AmendmentVisit: AmendmentVisit.Checked,
                                Confidential: Confidential.Checked,
                                SecurityAreas: SecurityAreas.Checked,
                                UnclassifiedRestricted: UnclassifiedRestricted.Checked,
                                /*Sites: Sites.Value,
                                Visitors: Visitors.Value,*/
                                Sites: CountIf(colAnnex1, !IsBlank(Trim(AgencyName))),
                                Visitors: CountIf(colAnnex2, !IsBlank(Trim(ParticularSurname))),
                                VIP: VIP.Checked,
                                Requestor: Requestor.Text,
                                Requestee: Requestee.Text,
                                ReferenceNumber: ReferenceNumber.Text,
                                Date: Date.SelectedDate,
                                RequestingAgencyMilitary: RequestingAgencyMilitary.Checked,
                                RequestingAgencyGovernment: RequestingAgencyGovernment.Checked,
                                RequestingAgencyIndustry: RequestingAgencyIndustry.Checked,
                                RequestingAgencyNATO: RequestingAgencyNATO.Checked,
                                RequestingAgencyEU: RequestingAgencyEU.Checked,
                                RequestingAgencyOther: RequestingAgencyOther.Checked,
                                RequestingAgencyName: RequestingAgencyName.Text,
                                RequestingAgencyPostal: RequestingAgencyPostal.Text,
                                RequestingAgencyEmail: RequestingAgencyEmail.Text,
                                RequestingAgencyFaxNumber: RequestingAgencyFaxNumber.Text,
                                RequestingAgencyTelephoneNumber: RequestingAgencyTelephoneNumber.Text,
                                VisitDateFrom: VisitDateFrom.SelectedDate,
                                VisitDateTo: VisitDateTo.SelectedDate,
                                GovernmentInitiative: GovernmentInitiave.Checked,
                                CommercialInitiative: CommercialInitiave.Checked,
                                InitiatedByRequestingAgency: InitiatedByRequestingAgency.Checked,
                                ByInvitationOfFacility: ByInvitationOfFacility.Checked,
                                /*PertinentToEquipment: PertinentToEquipment.Checked,
                                PertinentToSales: PertinentToSales.Checked,
                                PertinentToProgramme: PertinentToProgramme.Checked,
                                PertinentToDefense: PertinentToDefence.Checked,
                                PertinentToOther: PertinentToOther.Checked,
                                PertinenceSpecification: PertinenceSpecification.Text,*/
                                Pertinence: If(
                                    Pertinence.Selected.Value = "Other",
                                    "Other - " & Trim('PertinenceSpecification-'.Text),
                                    Pertinence.Selected.Value
                                ),
                                Subject: Subject.HtmlText,
                                LevelUnclassified: LevelUnclassified.Checked,
                                LevelRestricted: LevelRestricted.Checked,
                                LevelConfidential: LevelConfidential.Checked,
                                LevelSecret: LevelSecret.Checked,
                                LevelTopSecret: LevelTopSecret.Checked,
                                LevelOther: LevelOther.Checked,
                                LevelSpecify: LevelSpecify.Text,
                                SecurityOfficerName: SecurityOfficerName.Text,
                                SecurityOfficerTelephone: SecurityOfficerTelephone.Text,
                                SecurityOfficerEmail: SecurityOfficerEmail.Text,
                                SecurityOfficerSignature: SecurityOfficerSignature.Text,
                                CertificationName: CertificationName.Text,
                                CertificationAddress: CertificationAddress.Text,
                                CertificationTelephone: CertificationTelephone.Text,
                                CertificationEmail: CertificationEmail.Text,
                                CertificationSignature: CertificationSignature.Text,
                                CertificationDate: CertificationDate.SelectedDate,
                                AuthorityName: AuthorityName.Text,
                                AuthorityAddress: AuthorityAddress.Text,
                                AuthorityTelephone: AuthorityTelephone.Text,
                                AuthorityEmail: AuthorityEmail.Text,
                                AuthoritySignature: AuthoritySignature.Text,
                                AuthorityDate: AuthorityDate.SelectedDate,
                                Remarks: Remarks.HtmlText,

                                EmerContactDate: EmerContactDate.SelectedDate,
                                EmerContactDelegateName: EmerContactDelegateName.Text,
                                EmerContactUKAddress: EmerContactUKAddress.Text,
                                EmerContactCanadianPhone: EmerContactCanadianPhone.Text,
                                EmerContactUKPhone: EmerContactUKPhone.Text,
                                EmerContactPersonalEmail: EmerContactPersonalEmail.Text,

                                EmerFlightArrNumber: EmerFlightArrNumber.Text,
                                EmerFlightArrDate: If(
                                    IsBlank(EmerFlightArrDate.SelectedDate),
                                    Blank(),
                                    DateTime(
                                        Year(EmerFlightArrDate.SelectedDate),
                                        Month(EmerFlightArrDate.SelectedDate),
                                        Day(EmerFlightArrDate.SelectedDate),
                                        Value(EmerFlightArrHour.Selected.Hour),
                                        Value(EmerFlightArrMinute.Selected.Minute),
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                EmerFlightArrAirport: EmerFlightArrAirport.Text,

                                EmerFlightDepNumber: EmerFlightDepNumber.Text,
                                EmerFlightDepDate: If(
                                    IsBlank(EmerFlightDepDate.SelectedDate),
                                    Blank(),
                                    DateTime(
                                        Year(EmerFlightDepDate.SelectedDate),
                                        Month(EmerFlightDepDate.SelectedDate),
                                        Day(EmerFlightDepDate.SelectedDate),
                                        Value(EmerFlightDepHour.Selected.Hour),
                                        Value(EmerFlightDepMinute.Selected.Minute),
                                        0
                                    )
                                ),
                                EmerFlightDepAirport: EmerFlightDepAirport.Text,

                                /*EmerContactName: EmerContactName.Text,*/
                                /*EmerStreet: EmerStreet.Text,
                                EmerCity: EmerCity.Text,
                                EmerProvince: EmerProvince.Text,*/
                                /*EmerContactPostal: EmerContactPostal.Text,
                                EmerContactTelArea: EmerContactTelArea.Text,
                                EmerContactTel: EmerContactTel.Text,
                                EmerContactDayArea: EmerContactDayArea.Text,
                                EmerContactDayTel: EmerContactDayTel.Text,*/
                                /*EmerContactSignature: EmerContactSignature.Text,
                                EmerContactSignerName: EmerContactSignerName.Text,*/

                                'Annex 1': JSON(colAnnex1, JSONFormat.IgnoreBinaryData),
                                'Annex 2': JSON(colAnnex2, JSONFormat.IgnoreBinaryData)
                            }

{
                                request_user: {

                                },

                                Destination: If(Destination_1.Selected.Value = "British Overseas Territories (BOTs)", Destination_1.Selected.Value & " - " & BOT_1.Text, Destination_1.Selected.Value),

                                UnclassifiedRestricted: UnclassifiedRestricted_1.Checked,
                                /*Sites: Sites.Value,
                                Visitors: Visitors.Value,*/
                                Sites: CountIf(colAnnex1, !IsBlank(Trim(AgencyName))),
                                Visitors: CountIf(colAnnex2, !IsBlank(Trim(ParticularSurname))),
                                VIP: VIP_1.Checked,
                                Requestor: Requestor_1.Text,
                                Requestee: Requestee_1.Text,
                                ReferenceNumber: ReferenceNumber_1.Text,

                                RequestingAgencyEU: RequestingAgencyEU_1.Checked,

                                RequestingAgencyPostal: RequestingAgencyPostal_1.Text,
                                RequestingAgencyEmail: RequestingAgencyEmail_1.Text,
                                RequestingAgencyFaxNumber: RequestingAgencyFaxNumber_1.Text,
                                RequestingAgencyTelephoneNumber: RequestingAgencyTelephoneNumber_1.Text,
                                VisitDateFrom: VisitDateFrom_1.SelectedDate,
                                VisitDateTo: VisitDateTo_1.SelectedDate,
                                GovernmentInitiative: GovernmentInitiave.Checked,
                                CommercialInitiative: CommercialInitiave.Checked,
                                InitiatedByRequestingAgency: InitiatedByRequestingAgency.Checked,
                                ByInvitationOfFacility: ByInvitationOfFacility.Checked,
                                /*PertinentToEquipment: PertinentToEquipment.Checked,
                                PertinentToSales: PertinentToSales.Checked,
                                PertinentToProgramme: PertinentToProgramme.Checked,
                                PertinentToDefense: PertinentToDefence.Checked,
                                PertinentToOther: PertinentToOther.Checked,
                                PertinenceSpecification: PertinenceSpecification.Text,*/

                                    Pertinence_1.Selected.Value = "Other",
                                    "Other - " & Trim('PertinenceSpecification-'.Text),
                                    Pertinence_1.Selected.Value

                                LevelOther: LevelOther.Checked,
                                LevelSpecify: LevelSpecify.Text,
